name: PostHog
one_liner: PostHog is an all-in-one product data platform (analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, data warehouse) with an API and an official MCP server for agents.

auth.note: Personal API keys, project secret API keys (beta), and OAuth for private endpoints
OAuth 2.0 for third-party apps, with CIMD client registration

access.note: Free usage with no trial needed
Free setup, no credit card required

api_surface.note: API covers nearly all PostHog data: public capture/flags endpoints plus private CRUD endpoints

mcp.note: Hosted official MCP server at mcp.posthog.com/mcp

verdict.note: Documented API with self-serve keys and OAuth
Free to use, no sales gate

notes: OAuth 2.0 is documented for third-party apps, so it is listed as primary even though personal API keys are simpler. Project secret API keys are beta. The MCP server accepts OAuth or a personal API key. Admin requirement for installs is not shown in the fetched pages.

name: PagerDuty
one_liner: PagerDuty is an incident management and on-call platform that detects, triages and remediates production incidents, with a REST API, Events API, and an official hosted MCP server.

auth.note: Scoped and Classic OAuth 2.0 for third-party apps calling the REST API; API keys also exist
Account and user API tokens via Authorization header

access.note: Self-serve trial signup with work email
Scoped OAuth app works on the creating account immediately; publishing for other accounts needs admin install

api_surface.note: REST API, Events API v1/v2, SCIM, MCP and integration APIs with try-it console

mcp.note: Official PagerDuty-hosted MCP server at mcp.pagerduty.com/mcp

verdict.note: Documented REST API with token auth; self-serve trial

notes: Account API tokens can only be generated by account admins. Publishing a Scoped OAuth app to other accounts requires an admin install on each account. User API keys need Advanced Permissions. Local MCP server is deprecated; hosted MCP supports OAuth (CIMD, no DCR) and API keys. Events API and webhooks also exist.
